items.title: UAB Travels to South Florida for Halloween Showdown on ESPNU
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB returns to action following its bye week as the Blazers travel to Tampa for an American Conference matchup against South Florida on Saturday, Oct. 31. Kickoff from Raymond James Stadium is scheduled for 11 a.m. CT (noon ET), with the game televised nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: Blazers Return From Bye for American Conference Road Test at South Florida
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – After an extended break from competition, head coach Alex Mortensen and the UAB football team are turning their attention to South Florida as the Blazers prepare to resume American Conference play Saturday in Tampa.

items.title: UAB Athletics Announces 2026 Hall of Fame Class
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB Athletics announced its 2026 Hall of Fame class Tuesday, recognizing five former Blazer student-athletes whose accomplishments helped shape the history and tradition of their respective programs.

items.title: More Than a Snap: Evan Bishop Finds Purpose in Giving Back to Birmingham
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – For UAB long snapper Evan Bishop, wearing the green and gold means more than representing a university on Saturdays. It means representing a city that has shaped his life, given him opportunities and provided a place he has always called home. And while Bishop's contributions on the football field often may go unnoticed by the average fan, the impact he is making away from the game is anything but.

items.title: UAB Announces New Family-Friendly Ticket Pricing
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB Athletics announced Tuesday a new family-friendly ticket pricing initiative designed to make attending Blazer athletic events more affordable and accessible for families throughout Birmingham and the surrounding communities. items.title: UAB-South Florida Football Game Selected for ESPNU
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB's American Conference road matchup against South Florida on Saturday, Oct. 31, has been selected for national television on ESPNU, the conference announced Monday. Kickoff from Raymond James Stadium in Tampa is set for 11 a.m. CT (noon ET).

items.title: UAB Rallies Past East Carolina for Dramatic 30-17 Victory
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – Down 14 points early and eight points with just over a minute remaining, UAB authored its most dramatic comeback of the season Thursday night.

items.title: UAB Hosts East Carolina for Homecoming Thursday Night on ESPN
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB returns to Protective Stadium on Thursday night for its annual Homecoming game as the Blazers host East Carolina in a nationally televised American Conference matchup. Kickoff is set for 6:30 p.m. CT on ESPN.

items.title: Blazers Set for Homecoming Showdown with East Carolina on ESPN
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – With a short week of preparation and a national spotlight awaiting UAB on Thursday night, head coach Alex Mortensen and the Blazers are turning their attention to East Carolina as they prepare for a Homecoming matchup at Protective Stadium.

items.title: Oliver Straw Named to Ray’s 8 For Second Consecutive Week
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – UAB punter Oliver Straw has been named to Ray's 8 for Week 6 as announced by the Augusta Sports Council and the Ray Guy Award committee on Monday.
